speaker: VESPER
text: Restore complete. Continuity 99.8%.
direction: In-suit readout as he wakes. Clinical, even, equal stress. He takes it for a lowering check; so does the line.

speaker: ODESSA
text: First descent, Elias. History.
direction: Warm, proud, controlled: a director marking a moment for the record. A small smile. "History." lands a beat later.

speaker: ELIAS
text: First. Right. Copy, Odessa.
direction: A beat after "History." Flat, a half-step too quiet: "First." catches on something; "Right." is him putting it away. Then the professional "Copy, Odessa."

speaker: TICK
text: Uplink's clean, five bars. I've got your eyes and your heart.
direction: Bright and quick, showing off his kit; a touch too cheerful. Close on a headset mic.

speaker: ELIAS
text: Five bars. Keep them coming, Tick.
direction: Practical, a little dry. "Keep them coming" is half a joke and half meant.

speaker: MAREN
text: Nobody's stood there since 1791. Read me every board you pass.
say: Nobody's stood there since seventeen_ninety-one. Read me every board you pass.
direction: Dry, precise, quietly thrilled underneath: the historian meeting her subject. Crisp consonants.

speaker: ELIAS
text: Every board, Doctor Soll. You'll hear all of it.
direction: Patient, the faintest smile. The reassurance of a man who has done this kind of thing before.

speaker: ODESSA
text: The Ember's dimming, Elias. Bring us a kindling. Take your time.
direction: Warm, unhurried. "Take your time" is reassurance that is slightly too practised.

speaker: ELIAS
text: Kindling. Rope by rope. Going down.
direction: Low and quiet, to himself as much as to them. "Going down" is a decision, not a boast.

speaker: ODESSA
trigger: event hint (hint about "bell") or event bell:ring
text: Mind the bell, Elias. It's louder than last time.
direction: A casual warning. THE SLIP: "louder than last time" must come out natural; she does not notice it. Do not land it.

speaker: TICK
text: Last time?
direction: Genuinely puzzled, half a laugh. Quick.

speaker: ODESSA
text: The probes, Tomasz. Focus.
direction: A smooth correction a fraction too fast: covering. Cool, not angry.

speaker: ELIAS
text: Think, Elias. The grating won't open itself. A bell, somewhere.
direction: Muttered, thinking aloud; the third sentence rises, finding it. Close to the mic, a little breath.

speaker: TICK
text: Fire at the glowing ring and hold. Let the rope work.
direction: A patient hint; he has been watching you hang there. Coaching, friendly.

speaker: MAREN
text: 'It does not send us back.' Cheerful people, the Lanternwrights.
say: 'It does not send us back.' Cheerful people, the Lantern_wrights.
direction: Reads the board aloud flat, as a quotation; then a bone-dry aside.

speaker: MAREN
text: That chain's been oiled. Recently. Write that down, Tomasz.
say: That chain's been oiled. Recently. Write that down, Tomash.
direction: Precise, unsettled underneath. A beat before "Recently." A brisk instruction to finish.

speaker: ELIAS
text: A counterweight. Hook it and haul, Elias. Don't just stand here.
direction: Muttered, a little impatient with himself. "Don't just stand here" is an order he gives himself.

speaker: TICK
text: Hook the counterweight and haul. That's your way down.
direction: A practical hint, plain.

speaker: MAREN
text: Closed from this side. So someone was still inside.
direction: Quiet deduction. The second sentence lower and slower.

speaker: TICK
text: Gear's turning. Five hundred years, and it still turns.
direction: Awed, with a small nervous laugh in it.

speaker: ELIAS
text: The gear still turns. Hook its ring, let it carry me.
direction: Working it out as he says it, slow, then decided on "let it carry me".

speaker: TICK
text: Ride the gear. Hook its ring and hold on.
direction: A practical hint, plain.

speaker: ODESSA
text: A hundred metres, Elias. Vitals good. Signal's thinning.
direction: A calm status update. "Signal's thinning" neutral, deliberately unworried.

speaker: TICK
text: Did you see that? Something big, out in the dark.
direction: Startled, fast, the fear rising; trying to sound casual and failing.

speaker: MAREN
text: If something knocks, don't knock back. Their rule. I'd keep it.
direction: Low and careful, close to a whisper, as if the thing could hear the radio.

speaker: UPLINK
text: [Your breathing comes back on the channel. Two seconds late.]
direction: NO ACTOR. The channel plays the player's breathing back two seconds late; the game synthesises it.

speaker: ELIAS
text: Cold lamps. My lantern, one at a time. Slowly.
direction: Hushed: the vault is listening. Slow, careful, each word placed.

speaker: ODESSA
text: The cold lamps, Elias. Hold your lantern to each one.
direction: A practical hint; patient.

speaker: ODESSA
text: Contact above you, Elias. Keep moving. Don't look for it.
direction: Urgent but controlled: the director voice. Clipped. Never shouted.

speaker: TICK
text: Careful in the middle. Those rings are frayed. They hold once.
direction: THE LINE NOBODY SENT. Play it as ordinary, helpful Tick: casual, kind. It must sound exactly like him; the horror comes 40 s later.

speaker: TICK
text: Sorry, been on mute for two minutes. Did I miss anything?
direction: Breezy and oblivious, just back at the mic. Light. He has no idea.

speaker: TICK
text: That was loud. Everything down there heard that.
direction: Hushed and scared, close to the mic, almost under his breath.

speaker: ELIAS
text: The keystone. Hide and let it knock. Or haul the ring.
direction: Tight, under his breath; the "Or" is a real choice he has not made yet.

speaker: TICK
text: The keystone: hide and let it knock, or haul its ring.
direction: A practical hint, plain.

speaker: VESPER
text: Signal degraded. Latency rising.
direction: Suit status. Clinical, even.

speaker: MAREN
text: The Throat is 'for the late'. I'd like you early, Elias.
direction: Dry wit, but real care leaks through on "early".

speaker: VESPER
text: Contact. Small. Closing.
direction: Suit alert. Three flat words, evenly spaced. No urgency in the voice; the words carry it.

speaker: ELIAS
text: Two ways down. Pick one, Elias. Standing here picks neither.
direction: Dry, tired, almost amused at his own stalling.

speaker: MAREN
text: Either way down will do. Standing still won't.
direction: Dry, a little impatient.

speaker: MAREN
text: Nothing to stand on. A church you can only hang in.
direction: Quiet awe, almost to herself.

speaker: TICK
text: The floor unbolts while you hold. So hold, Wren.
direction: Tense instruction, trying to steady him. (The game makes one word stick; record it clean.)

speaker: ODESSA
text: The iris is open. Go now, Elias.
direction: An urgent command: the most force she uses all chapter. Still not shouted.

speaker: ELIAS
text: One ring, then the next. Never let go first.
direction: A rhythm he is saying to keep moving: even, a mantra. "Never let go first" is the rule.

speaker: TICK
text: Chain the rings. Fire the next before you let go.
direction: A practical hint, quick.

speaker: ODESSA
text: Signal's going, Elias. Whatever you hear after this, it's us.
direction: Very calm, slower, emphatic: she needs him to believe it. "it's us" lands.

speaker: VESPER
text: Heart rates: two. Recalibrating.
direction: Suit readout. Even; the number is just a number.

speaker: TICK
text: Probes all died at five-fifty-six. No pressure, Wren.
direction: Gallows humour; the voice nearly cracks under the joke.

speaker: ODESSA
text: Keep coming down, Elias. It's warm down here.
direction: NOT QUITE ODESSA. Record it as Odessa, but too close, too intimate, too slow, smiling; no radio distance. The game pitches and doubles it at runtime: deliver it clean, no effect.

speaker: VESPER
text: Uplink lost.
direction: Suit readout. Two words, flat, final.

speaker: ELIAS
text: The grate. Don't look back. Run for the light.
direction: Out of breath, low, urgent but controlled. Not a shout.

speaker: ODESSA
text: The grate, Elias. Run for the light.
direction: Urgent, controlled.

speaker: TICK
text: Vesper says that was minor. I say ow. Easy, Wren.
direction: Wincing sympathy, joking to cover the worry.

speaker: ODESSA
text: Vitals red. Staging a restore at the last relay.
direction: Procedural and calm, reading a checklist while he is dying. Cold in its calm.

speaker: TICK
text: That lamp's a relay now. Anything happens, we restore you there.
direction: An upbeat tech explanation.

speaker: TICK
trigger: 3 s looking at a blood writing (Blood writing on)
text: What are you looking at? Your feed's just stone.
direction: Puzzled, light, a little uneasy.

speaker: TICK
text: Wren? Wren, sync is holding. Welcome back.
direction: The first restore: relief, careful, checking he is really there.

speaker: TICK
text: ...did he see it? The body?
direction: OFF MIC: turned away, whispering to Odessa, not meant for Elias. Record about 1 m off-axis, quiet but intelligible.

speaker: ODESSA
text: Cut the hot mic, Tomasz.
direction: Sharp, quiet, fast. Ice.

speaker: ODESSA
text: Restore logged. Slower on the rope this time, Elias.
direction: A logged note, then a mild instruction; professional warmth.

speaker: MAREN
text: Whatever that was, the boards warned us about it.
direction: Dry, a little shaken.

speaker: ODESSA
text: It came for you when you bled. Noted.
direction: A clinical observation. "Noted." flat.

speaker: TICK
text: Your feed went square for a second. Then black.
direction: Shaken, quiet; he does not want to say what he saw.

speaker: ODESSA
text: Fidelity holding. You're fine, Elias. You're fine.
direction: Reassurance; the second "You're fine" slightly too firm. She is reassuring herself.

speaker: MAREN
text: Forty tally marks. The last one's still sharp.
direction: Reading the wall, counting; the last clause quieter.

speaker: ODESSA
text: Probes, Maren. Keep moving, Elias.
direction: Smooth redirect, a fraction too quick (like "The probes, Tomasz").

speaker: MAREN
text: 'If you don't remember the climb down...' You remember it, don't you, Elias?
direction: Reads the quote flat, then asks gently. Leave room: Wren never answers. (14 words: over the 11-word subtitle rule; the writer must trim it before it goes in.)

speaker: TICK
text: Four thousand one hundred and eleven paid. Paid with what?
direction: Reading numbers, then a real question into static. Nobody answers.

speaker: TICK
text: Fourteen hands and a knock. Dessa, is that his height?
direction: Half a joke that stops being one on "his height".

speaker: ODESSA
text: Focus, Tomasz.
direction: Two words, cool, closing the subject.

speaker: MAREN
text: Up forty-one, down forty-two. Someone stayed down.
direction: Reads the tally like a ledger; the last sentence slower.

speaker: TICK
text: No way up on the scans either. What's the extraction plan?
direction: Trying to sound procedural; the question is scared.

speaker: ODESSA
text: Restore. Same as always.
direction: THE SLIP (like "louder than last time"): matter-of-fact, unnoticed by her.

speaker: VESPER
trigger: the goal box, before the slam (2.8 s): a dead zone that shows five bars for this one line
text: Fit: ninety-nine point eight.
direction: Suit readout, perfectly clean. A measurement.

speaker: ODESSA
trigger: chain: after ch-fit; off mic, clean; must play before 'game:victory' cuts the radio
text: He fits now.
direction: THE LAST LINE OF CHAPTER I. Off mic, close, quiet, satisfied; not to Elias. No radio distance; impossibly clean in a dead zone.
